# Motivations for an Overhaul

![](img%5CE90%20Mid-Semester%20Reivew8.jpg)

| Outdated Chassis Model | Current chassis was made in ‘13 <br />No aerodynamic considerations<br />New size requirements |
| :-: | :-: |
| Hydraulic Brakes | Hydraulic disk-pad brakes are standardized and required  |
| Outdated Materials | Aluminum chassis adds unnecessary weight and is restricting performance |
| New front and rear suspension  | Front suspension is hefty and complicates steering<br />No rear suspension system |
| Steering and Driver Safety Systems | Steering columns need to be redesigned for turning radius requirements<br />Safety electronics need an update |
| Fuel Cell Woes | Current FC is inconsistent and needs to be assessed for further use |

# Fuel Cell Renewal & Feasibility Assessment

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

# Current FC woes

# H2 gas moves along a membrane where it merges with O2 gas to make water and electricity

An electric motor powers the vehicle -> 0 emission kinematic propulsion!

# FC was bought in ‘19 and has had multiple start-up issues

Possible need for FC rehydration & system renewals

No benchmarking of potential power

# Fuel Efficiency is King!

# Shell Eco-Marathon measures the amount of hydrogen used to drive 3.9kms in less than 35 mins.

# Weight kills efficiency

# 240+ MPG Gained

# A potential >20% fuel efficiency increase by swapping to lighter material!
